notes: Page 74: day 18 closes with the short memorial ¶፳፱ (John/Adrani/Artemaos etc., no arke); day 19 opens (አመ ፲ወ፱) with Bartholomew and wife (¶፩-፬ + arke), then a second commemoration, the council on Paul of Samosata (¶፭ onward, continues p075). Numerals ፳፱ ፫ ፬ ፭ and the Amharic ones are small/dotted; inferred from sequence. Ge'ez ¶፳፱ "ወ፯ቱ ደቂቃ" read by pattern from Amharic "የሰባቱ ልጆቿ"; scan blurred. Amharic "ልጆቿ" scan reads "ልጀቿ"-like. ¶፩ opener: "አሐዱ" printed as numeral glyph in scan, kept as አሐዱ per earlier pages. Amharic ¶፩ number word "ዐሥራ ዘጠኝ" inferred from ፲ወ፱ (scan has the word dotted: "ዐሥራ ዘጠኝ"); Amharic ወነጀሏቸው (scan ሏ/ላ unclear). Ge'ez ወአስተዋደይዎሙ, ዐዘቅተ, ዘሕፅን, በዘአክረየ in the arke are doubtful words (ዘሕፅን, ዘአክረየ unclear; line break splits ዘአ|ክረየ). Ge'ez ¶፬ ኪያነኒ ይምሐረነ by pattern (scan prints ኪያንኒ ይምሐረን). Page ends mid-word in both columns: Ge'ez "ላዕ" (continues ላዕለ on p075, join without space), Amharic "በእ" (join without space). Amharic has no arke. Amharic ኤጲስቆጶስነት spelled as one word per scan.
